summary: Four harness tests before this file was written. Test 2 found: (1) lm-eval logs a chat request's context as [[context], generation settings], so the join by messages sha failed on every item; the unwrapping was fixed and the saved test data re-joined offline 6/6 on GSM8K and IFEval with identical output text; (2) test mode passed MMLU sample ids for 6 subjects only, and lm-eval runs any subject missing from the dict in full (13,152 items ran); test mode now lists every subject (the measured run lists all 57, as bound in mmlu_sample_ids.json); (3) the proxy opened a new upstream connection per request and ran out of local ports on Ollama (407 of 3,528 requests failed with WinError 10048 and were retried by lm-eval); it now keeps one upstream connection per handler thread. From the 13,152 NIM MMLU requests of that test: every output was a single letter continuing the assistant prefix (' A' to ' D'), finish_reason stop, with continue_final_message=true and add_generation_prompt=false accepted by NIM 2.0.12; Ollama's 3,121 successful requests also answered with one letter. Prompt tokens: NIM counted exactly 25 more than Ollama on every item compared (6 GSM8K, 6 IFEval, 3,109 MMLU), the same 25 as the one-word probe (36 against 11): a constant chat-template difference. `ollama show` reported O-Q4's quantization as Q4_K_M. Test 3 was contaminated: the stopped test 2's process (the venv launcher and its child) was still running and kept sending requests to the new O-Q4 container (health read 0.074, the proxy saw 0 GSM8K requests); both processes were stopped, the container removed, and test 3 discarded. Test 4 (clean, 3 items per task): O-Q4 health 0.531, N-BF16 0.801; every item joined (3 / 3 / 57 per arm), request sha256 identical between the arms on every item (G4), prompt tokens within 0% after the 25-token offset (G2 part a); one N-BF16 GSM8K item reached the 256-token cap by repeating a sentence (finish_reason length), which fails G2 part b for that cell in the test; the recompute check reproduced analysis.json byte for byte from the published files and its negative control changed it. Added after the tests: a sensitivity reading (the paired comparison over items where neither arm hit the output cap), reported and never a verdict. The G1 scorer controls ran once, before any model output, while the Q2/Q4 run was on the GPU (CPU only).
